name: P2 UI
about: Visual polish so Assign vs Refuse reads from across the table

## Goal

Pass and refuse are obvious from three meters. Not Alder Health parchment.

## Owns

`web/index.html` `web/styles.css` `web/app.js` `web/display.json`

## Done when

- [ ] Assign is green, Refuse is red, decision type ~28px
- [ ] T-14 badge reads Out of service
- [ ] Confirm is the biggest button; disabled on Refuse
- [ ] After Confirm, T-11 looks busy
- [ ] Desktop 1280 and mobile 375 still layout
- [ ] No new vehicles, cities, or rule text
